note: B23 back yard, La piste: the garage's traffic-education garden, camera at the garage back door facing east. Grey mini roads with white dashes, cobbled kerbs, lawns, plane trees, a stream; landmark: the little stone humpback bridge. Feminine LEFT: goose on the last seat of the bench in the tiny square by the fountain (place); pig looking rueful at his dropped ice cream on the little street (rue); rabbit in a pedal go-kart bumping over the tree root that burst through the road (route); boy in a helmet on a new scooter down the avenue (avenue); frog in a bandsman's jacket beating a drum as he marches (marche). Masculine RIGHT: showman in a top hat strolling the winding gravel path (chemin); chess pawn at the humpback bridge (pont); pony trotting along the pavement (trottoir); bulldog in a beret strutting down the boulevard (boulevard); cat popping out through the clipped hedge (à travers). Exits: green back door of the garage near left -> R_road_03 (sign 'La piste' on its lintel board); timber bike shelter left -> R_road_01_z1; gravel path running on ahead -> R_road_01_z2. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p4).
